/bin/zsh -lc "ls -la /Applications; ls -la /private/tmp; node -e \"console.log(process.version)\"; python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text()
class Page(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.tags=Counter(); self.links=[]; self.stack=[]; self.errors=[]
 def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
  a=dict(attrs); self.tags[tag]+=1
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='a':self.links.append(a.get('href',''))
page=Page();page.feed(s)
print('Bytes:',p.stat().st_size)
print('Duplicate IDs:',[i for i,n in Counter(page.ids).items() if n>1])
print('Missing link targets:',[h for h in page.links if h.startswith('#') and len(h)>1 and h[1:] not in page.ids])
print('Sections:',page.tags['section'],'Forms:',page.tags['form'])
print('Files:',[str(p) for p in Path('.').iterdir()])
print('Remote images:', 'https:' in ''.join(__import__('re').findall(r'<(?:img|image)["'^>]*>'"',s)))
PY"

import re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__(); self.stack=[]; self.errors=[]; self.attrs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  self.attrs.append((tag,dict(attrs)))
  if tag not in {'meta','link','input','br','hr','img','area','base','col','embed','param','source','track','wbr'}:self.stack.append(tag)
 def handle_endtag(self,tag):
  if self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag:self.stack.pop()
  else:self.errors.append((tag,self.stack[-3:]))
c=Check();c.feed(s)
print('HTML nesting errors:',c.errors,'Unclosed:',c.stack)
ids={a['id'] for t,a in c.attrs if 'id' in a}
refs=[]
for t,a in c.attrs:
 for k in ['aria-describedby','aria-labelledby']:
  refs.extend(x for x in a.get(k,'').split() if x not in ids)
print('Missing ARIA references:',refs)
print('Text field samples:',len(re.findall(r'class=\"field-sample\"',s)))
print('Button samples:',len(re.findall(r'class=\"button-row\"',s)))
print('Transfer list panels:',len(re.findall(r'class=\"surface transfer-panel\"',s)))
print('Select options visible in open sample:',len(re.findall(r'class=\"select-option\"',s)))
copy=['Form and feedback components, each shown in every state.','Enter a 10-digit account number.','Account verified.','Accept the terms to continue.','Choose a frequency.','Choose an account.','No transfers match your search.','Transfers could not be loaded.','Transfers made after 6 pm are processed the next business day.','Your transfer was scheduled.','Your daily transfer limit is almost reached.','Your transfer could not be sent.','This action cannot be undone. Your remaining balance will be sent to your linked account.','Fix 2 errors to continue.','Enter an amount greater than "'$0.00.'"','"'$250.00 to Kaito Mori on 18 Oct 2026'"','© 2026 Harbor Bank']
print('Missing required copy:',[t for t in copy if t not in s])
js=re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',s,re.S).group(1)
r=subprocess.run(['node','--check'],input=js,text=True,capture_output=True)
print('JavaScript syntax:', 'PASS' if r.returncode==0 else r.stderr)
css=re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>',s,re.S).group(1)
print('CSS braces:',css.count('{'),css.count('}'))
print('Workspace files:',[p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir()])
PY"
